name: AGS Glossary
purpose: Provide official definitions for all technical terms used throughout the Astrological Grammar Standard.

terms.definition: A symbolic entity that performs a primary function in AGS.
A temporary emphasis of a natal function by a timing system.
A chart anchor defining orientation (ASC, DSC, MC, IC).
A geometric relationship connecting two functions.
A concrete aspect between two placements.
A foundational assumption accepted by the AGS specification.
A large developmental period represented by a return or similar timing cycle.
A complete symbolic document containing placements and relationships.
The deterministic assembly of entities into sentences.
A rule defining how valid entities combine.
The grammatical role supplied by an aspect.
The life domain supplied by a house.
The threshold through which a house is entered.
A positional nuance that refines expression.
The gradual evolution of a symbolic function.
The developmental orientation supplied by the lunar nodes.
A planet governing the sign occupied by another planet.
A machine-readable explanation showing how a sentence was produced.
The symbolic action supplied by an astrological actor.
A function expressed as a placement in a chart.
An ordered collection of composed sentences answering a query.
The grammatical identity assigned to an entity within AGS.
The context in which a function operates.
The actor responsible for carrying a house's topics.
An entity that changes how a function is expressed without replacing it.
Human-readable output generated from composed meanings.
The enduring symbolic structure derived from the birth chart.
A refinement added without changing the underlying function.
The formal catalogue of entities existing within AGS.
A function located in a sign, degree and optionally a house.
An astrological actor supplying the primary verb.
An internal timing technique describing gradual development.
A structured request selecting relevant chart entities.
A non-deterministic question derived from the composition.
A timing cycle reopening a natal function.
A deterministic grammatical output.
A modifier changing the manner of a function.
The authoritative definition of AGS.
A condition modifying how a function is expressed.
The focused actor supplying the primary verb.
A method activating natal grammar.
A current planetary position activating natal structure.
The primary grammatical role supplied by planets and luminaries.

styleRules: Definitions remain independent of individual planets, signs or houses.
Every technical document must use glossary terms consistently.
New terms require a version update.

versionHistory.change: Initial AGS glossary with core terminology.
